_comment: TEMPLATE for BOOTSTRAPPING a NEW molecule's per-molecule config.json only (bgconfig.make_config interpolates this by d). This central file is NEVER read during training: at runtime bgconfig.load_config(d, name) reads the authoritative, read-only <name>_<d>d/config.json. 'global' = template params identical for every new molecule. 'resource_anchors' = pool/batch/valid/hidden_width specified at two dimensions; any other d is linearly INTERPOLATED between them (clamped outside the range) when a new molecule's config is generated.
